ValidationRule.description: When setting the End Date, Recurrence Days cannot be empty, and the value cannot be less that Today + Recurrence Days.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISCHANGED(medallia_xm__End_Date__c), AND( ISCHANGED(medallia_xm__Recurrence_Days__c), NOT(ISNULL(medallia_xm__End_Date__c)) ), AND( ISNEW(), NOT(ISNULL(medallia_xm__End_Date__c)) ) ), IF(medallia_xm__End_Date__c < TODAY() + medallia_xm__Recurrence_Days__c, true, false) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: End Date value needs to be equal or greater than today plus Recurrence Days. Or at least, one more day from today if there is no Recurrence Days.
